question: James purchased a certain baseball card on January 1. The function f(x)=85(1.04)^x, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 10, gives the predicted value, in dollars, of the baseball card x years after James purchased it. What is the best interpretation of the statement "f(8) is approximately equal to 116" in this context?
a: When the baseball card's predicted value is approximately 116 dollars, it is 8% greater than the predicted value, in dollars, on January 1 of the previous year.
b: When the baseball card's predicted value is approximately 116 dollars, it is 8 times the predicted value, in dollars, on January 1 of the previous year.
c: From the day James purchased the baseball card to 8 years after James purchased the card, its predicted value increased by a total of approximately 116 dollars.
d: 8 years after James purchased the baseball card, its predicted value is approximately 116 dollars.
